items.title: 美國科羅拉多州供水企業遭駭，攻擊者直接干擾OT系統運作
items.summary: 供水系統攸關民生，其穩定運作也是關鍵基礎設施的重要議題。美國科羅拉多州州長辦公室近日向Denver Post等媒體證實，兩家私人供水企業於8月底遭外國攻擊者入侵，攻擊者修改設備設定、停用遠端存取與警報，並改變抽水週期，但影響時間短暫，未造成供水服務或公共安全問題。兩家遭受攻擊的企業均為小型供水業者，服務對象均不到200人，目前科羅拉多官方尚未確認攻擊者身分。

items.title: Cloudflare無伺服器運算平臺正式支援Python，Web框架、資料庫與AI套件一併補齊
items.summary: Cloudflare旗下無伺服器運算平臺Workers的Python執行環境Python Workers正式上線，結束自2024年開始的測試階段。Python成為Cloudflare Developer Platform正式支援的程式語言，可使用Workers AI、R2、D1、Hyperdrive、Durable Objects、Queues與Workflows等服務。FastAPI、Django及Flask等Python Web框架也能在Workers環境執行。

items.title: Amazon封鎖Meta Muse，禁止AI代理人代替用戶購物
items.summary: Meta於9月8日推出個人AI代理人Muse，可替使用者瀏覽網站、填寫表格、購物及預約服務。不過，Amazon本周證實已封鎖Muse存取Amazon.com，指其未經授權進入網站，且未表明AI代理人身分，違反Amazon使用條款。

items.title: Google位置資料處理違反GDPR，遭愛爾蘭重罰4.03億歐元
items.summary: 愛爾蘭資料保護委員會（Data Protection Commission，DPC）周一（9/21）宣布，Google處理使用者位置資料的方式違反歐盟《一般資料保護規則》（GDPR），包括資料處理的合法性、公平性、透明度及保存期限等規定，決定對Google開罰4.03億歐元，並要求Google在6個月內改善相關資料處理方式，使其符合GDPR規定。

items.title: 中國駭客Red Heron利用Gitea重大漏洞攻擊臺灣，工業自動化業者遭竊數百個程式碼儲存庫
items.summary: 日前資安公司Acronis揭露Gitea重大漏洞CVE-2026-60004的利用活動，並確認臺灣、加拿大、阿根廷、美國及斯里蘭卡均有組織遭到中國駭客Red Heron入侵，值得關注的是，臺灣不僅是這波攻擊鎖定的重點之一，其中有一家工業自動化業者更遭到竊取數百個程式碼儲存庫，是研究人員發現遭竊資料量最大的受害案例。

items.title: 美國CISA警告兆勤交換器高風險漏洞遭積極利用
items.summary: 9月21日美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）發布警訊，指出已掌握兆勤（Zyxel）GS1900交換器高風險漏洞CVE-2026-7273遭積極利用的證據，將其列入已遭利用的漏洞名單（KEV），聯邦機構需在9月24日

items.title: fix(gateway): named preference reads fail on multi-agent gateways (#1…
items.summary: fix(gateway): named preference reads fail on multi-agent gateways (#147930) Related: #126360 ## What Problem This Solves Fixes named preference reads being rejected as session reads on multi-agent Gateways without a legacy default session owner. ## User Impact Non-admin users can read their own named preferences, including names that resemble incognito session identifiers. Existing session visibility and incognito restrictions remain in effect. No configuration, stored-data migration or permission-policy change is required. ## Why This Change Was Made `users.prefs.get` uses `keys` for profile-owned preference names, not session targets. Limit that interpretation to `sessions.*` methods while preserving the existing explicit session-key fields and authorization owners. ## Evidence - The contributor's retained real Gateway/WebSocket before-and-after proof distinguishes ordinary and incognito-looking preference names from actual foreign-session targets. It is retained rather than blindly replayed. - The [hosted authenticated regression](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35609687706/job/106366463808) passed within its 151-test group. Its original fixture is byte-identical to the contributor head; the relevant direct/incognito target classifiers also match. Unrelated approval-helper differences prevent a whole-module identity claim. - The simplified regression passes through a real listener, signed paired Control UI connection, trusted-proxy identity, non-admin scopes and native storage. It verifies named reads, profile identity, successful own-session preview and denied foreign-session preview. - Removed diagnostic logging and assertions that merely repeated configuration inputs. All observable RPC checks remain. The test shrank from 137 to 119 lines without a new helper or production seam. - The modified test passed: 10.740 seconds test time, 37.26 seconds wall time including cold worker preparation, on Node 24.21.0. Scoped type-aware lint, formatting, source-size ratchets and whitespace checks passed. No new full build or repository-wide test run is claimed. The retained hosted run had failures in other groups; it is not represented as a green full CI run. Fresh checks apply to the final published head. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: refactor(mcp): run OAuth writes and leases in the state worker (#148859)
items.summary: refactor(mcp): run OAuth writes and leases in the state worker (#148859) * refactor(mcp): run OAuth writes through owned state workers * fix(state): release stopped heartbeat reference Drop the retained worker heartbeat only after all heartbeat cleanup joins succeed. Escaped lease callbacks must not retain its completed caller context. Failed teardown keeps its original retry custody and uncertainty barrier. * test(memory): report FTS setup errors Include the existing schema error in the unchanged FTS availability assertion so the next hosted failure exposes its setup cause before purge execution. This adds diagnostics without changing the expected result or skipping FTS.
